scope: Section structure and persuasion approach; no claims of conversion uplift or independent competitor efficacy testing.

sources.observed: Official page and browser accessibility tree: gallery includes product, texture, short introduction video, application before/after, full face application and mood product; lower page separates benefits, ingredients and a beauty tip specifying use after makeup on chin/nose/cheeks.
sources.inference: Separate the unfamiliar format from the visible result and application location so customers can answer all three questions.
sources.adaptation: TAM first-screen continuous cheek application, location-labelled nose/forehead scenes, separate original texture photograph and amount-adjustment instruction.
sources.not_transferred: Neither alters makeup / no white cast / performance duration. Competitor photos, films and exact copy are not used.

sources.observed: Official page and browser accessibility tree: top description identifies transparent gel-like powder used over makeup; description compares it with blotting paper; separate Before & After Application section contains two images, with an artist/model testimonial and video section elsewhere.
sources.inference: An unfamiliar product benefits from a familiar use occasion and a visibly separated outcome section.
sources.adaptation: Blotting-paper occasion leads into the existing TAM oil-control plus cosmetic-blur benefit. Full application segments include the unobstructed finish rather than stopping while the puff covers the skin.
sources.not_transferred: Better absorption than blotting paper, longer lasting claims, celebrity endorsement, controlled before/after format. TAM evidence does not establish these.

sources.observed: Official text separates What it does, How to use and Before & After. Current Universal page emphasizes priming and instructs foundation application after the balm sets.
sources.inference: State role and timing explicitly; do not transfer a primer-first hierarchy to a touch-up-first brief.
sources.adaptation: Keep primer as the third supporting use case rather than the opening promise.
sources.not_transferred: Upsalite ingredient story, consumer percentages and 60-second application instruction.

visual_observation_limits: Browser DOM/AX section and media labels verified; reference screenshots showed incomplete rendering in this browser. No claim to have fully watched competitor videos or verified their claimed before/after conditions.

tam_design.goal: Immediately identify a balm for oil-control touch-ups over makeup, show the full application action and unobstructed finish, then explain the solid format and practical puff use.
tam_design.type: Existing TAM Pretendard Korean / small Manrope English. 32px hero, 28px section headings, 15px copy at 430px source width; fonts rasterized for delivery.
tam_design.signature: Large continuous first-screen application that finishes with the puff removed and holds on the skin.
sections: 02 oil-control plus cosmetic finish with product
05 shaped puff and real hand amount adjustment
tam_design.capability_decision: Existing FFmpeg, Pillow format conversion and local HTML raster exporter are sufficient. No installation. Blender would not establish on-skin behavior and is unnecessary for this evidence-led revision; no scene accessed. No generated skin or product texture.
tam_design.claim_boundary: Existing footage shows application, not a controlled makeup-retention or selective oil-removal test.
